reason: An evidence-grounded academic research plugin for discovering and retrieving public scholarly sources, assessing source coverage, and supporting bilingual literature review and citation-related workflows.

summaries.zh: 通过 Crossref、OpenAlex 和公开网页检索与获取学术资料，并辅助开展有证据边界的双语文献综述、学术写作和引文检查。
summaries.en: Search and retrieve public academic sources through Crossref, OpenAlex, and selected HTTPS pages while supporting evidence-aware bilingual literature reviews, academic writing, and citation checks.

capabilities: Searches public Crossref and OpenAlex research metadata
Fetches a specific allowlisted public HTTPS research record or paper page
Reports source coverage and evidence limitations
Supports bilingual literature review, academic writing, citation checking, and reviewer-response guidance
